scope: Surviving N2 concrete bridge, arch/spandrels/approach piers, roadway/parapets and intrinsic catwalk/central bungee platform only. Gorge, traffic, bungee ropes/people and detached visitor buildings excluded.

quallaSearch.notes: Already cleared local public-domain NJR ZA originals only. Unrelated historical railway/other bridges and incomplete attribution candidates excluded. No supplemental photograph or drawing used.

references.caption: Bloukrans Bridge, Eastern Cape, South Africa

originalReview.notes: Both full-size local NJR ZA originals inspected. Overall photo shows the single broad concrete arch and paired open spandrel columns, raised slab/parapets and approach supports; detail photo shows pale slit parapets, road slab, central steel bungee platform/catwalk. No people, vehicles, logos or active ropes modeled. Hidden sections and minor dimensions remain medium-fi estimates.
